title: 第4185章 很久很久了第4184章 还能怎么办
content_zh:
南天门世界。
艳阳高照。
一望无际的荒野上，李子夜、太商两人闲庭信步一般迈步前行，不紧不慢，悠然自得。
第一次，李子夜出门在外，没有用五行法阵去掩饰自己的气息和行踪，走路昂首挺胸，目空一切，将狐假虎威四个字，体现的淋漓尽致。
只可惜，两人所在的荒野，周围荒无人烟，除了孤狼和野兔，一个活物都看不到，没人能看到某人的嚣张嘴脸。
“老头，你说，前面那位大天尊有没有察觉我们的气息？”骄阳下，李子夜抬头看了一眼天际的太阳，一脸陶醉地沐浴着阳光，随口问道。
“应该察觉到了。”
一旁，太商回答道，“这么近的距离，他没理由察觉不到。”
“那他竟然没有跪着来迎接我们，当真失礼！”
李子夜十分不爽地说道，“这么不懂规矩，确实该杀！”
太商听到身旁小子之言，微笑道，“这位大天尊，气息没有白矖和黑麟那么强，应该是七位大天尊中排行比较靠后的一位，至于具体排名第几，老朽就不知道了。”
“管他第几，在您老人家面前，没有任何区别！”
李子夜大手一挥，满脸嚣张地说道，“只要遇到，全都杀了！”
他算是发现了，要是让他这样穷怕的人一朝得势，成功踏足三花境，那可真是这个世界的噩梦！
难道，这就是暴发户的嘴脸吗？真是痛快而又丑陋啊！
太商看着身旁小家伙快要飘起来的样子，笑了笑，没有多说什么。
一老一少交谈间，三百里的距离，转眼已过。
“前辈，还没到吗？”荒野上，李子夜左右看了看，不解地问道。
“到了。”太商回答道。
“哪里？”李子夜疑惑地问道。

“我们前方。”
太商应了一句，旋即右手挥过，顿时，一股无形气劲荡开，砰然一声将周围弥漫的领域法则震散。
瞬息后，两人前方，一座雄伟的宫殿显化而出，宫殿的外表看上去十分的奢华，在这一望无际的荒野上，显得如此突兀。
“哇哦。”
李子夜看到眼前荒野上出现的宫殿，称赞道，“在没有高大树木的荒原上，建这么一座宫殿，可不是一件容易的事，这位大天尊，当真品味独特！”
漠北八部，为何没有中原那么多奢华的行宫，最主要的原因就是漠北的树木都很矮小，草原不像中原，高大的树木很难生长，所以，草原的宫殿一般都比较简陋。
现在，他们所在荒原，地理环境和漠北那边差不多，要想在这里建造这么一座奢华的行宫，难度不是一般的大。
“九州的人族圣贤大驾光临，蓝溪，有失远迎，还望见谅。”
就在这时，两人前方的宫殿中，一道柔和的声音响起，随后，宫殿前，一抹美丽的倩影现身，亲自出来迎接两人。
百丈距离，李子夜看着前方大天尊，纵然见惯了各种风采各异的女子，在看到蓝溪大天尊后，还是不禁愣了一下。
倒不是蓝溪大天尊有多么美丽，主要是眼前女子看上去柔柔弱弱的，给人的感觉就是一位柔弱的普通女子，一点也不像一位大天尊级强者。
“蓝溪？”
太商听到这个名字，平静道，“名字不错。”
说完，太商就要抬手，将眼前大天尊连同其身后的宫殿一同灭了。
content_en:
Nantianmen World.
The sun is shining brightly.
In the endless wilderness, Li Ziye and Tai Shang walked forward like a leisurely stroll, unhurried and leisurely.
For the first time, Li Ziye went out without using the Five Elements Array to conceal his aura and whereabouts. He walked with his head high and his chest high, arrogant, and fully embodied the four words of a fox pretending to be a tiger's power.
It's a pity that the wilderness where the two of them are located is surrounded by deserted people. Except for lone wolves and hares, there is no living thing to see, and no one can see someone's arrogant face.
"Old man, tell me, has the Great Heavenly Lord in front noticed our aura?" Under the scorching sun, Li Ziye raised his head and glanced at the sun in the sky, bathing in the sunshine with an intoxicated look on his face, and asked casually.
"Should have noticed it."
On the side, Taishang replied, "There is no reason why he can't notice it at such a close distance."
"Then he didn't kneel down to greet us. How rude!"
Li Ziye said very unhappily, "You really don't understand the rules and you should be killed!"
Taishang heard the words of the boy next to him and smiled, "This Great Heavenly Lord's aura is not as strong as Bai Jin and Heilin. He should be ranked lower among the seven Great Heavenly Lords. As for the specific ranking, I don't know."
"It doesn't matter what rank he is in, it doesn't make any difference in front of you, old man!"
Li Ziye waved his hand and said with an arrogant expression, "If you encounter them, kill them all!"
He finally discovered that if a poor and fearful person like him were to gain power and successfully set foot in the Three Flowers Realm, it would really be a nightmare in this world!
Could it be that this is the face of the nouveau riche? It's so happy and ugly!
Taishang looked at the little guy next to him who was about to float, smiled, and said nothing more.
As the old man and the young man talked, the distance of three hundred miles passed in the blink of an eye.
"Senior, haven't you arrived yet?" In the wilderness, Li Ziye looked around and asked in confusion.
"We're here." Taishang replied.
"Where?" Li Ziye asked doubtfully.
"Ahead of us."
Tai Shang responded, and immediately waved his right hand. Suddenly, an invisible energy spread out, and with a bang, the surrounding domain laws were scattered.
A moment later, a majestic palace appeared in front of the two people. The appearance of the palace looked very luxurious, and it seemed so abrupt in this endless wilderness.
"Wow."
Li Ziye saw the palace appearing in the wilderness in front of him and praised, "It is not an easy task to build such a palace in the wilderness without tall trees. This Great Heavenly Lord really has unique taste!"
The main reason why there are not as many luxurious palaces in the Eight Parts of Mobei as there are in the Central Plains is that the trees in Mobei are very short. Unlike the Central Plains, the grasslands are difficult for tall trees to grow. Therefore, the palaces in the grasslands are generally relatively simple.
Now, the geographical environment of the wasteland they were in was similar to that of Mobei. It would be extremely difficult to build such a luxurious palace here.
"The human sages from Kyushu are here. Lan Xi, I hope you will forgive me for missing you from afar."
At this moment, a soft voice sounded in the palace in front of the two people. Then, a beautiful figure appeared in front of the palace and came out to greet the two people in person.
From a distance of a hundred feet, Li Ziye looked at the Great Heavenly Lord in front of him. Even though he was used to seeing all kinds of women with different styles, he couldn't help but be stunned when he saw the Great Heavenly Lord of Lanxi.
It's not that Lanxi Great Heavenly Lord is so beautiful, it's mainly that the woman in front of her looks soft and frail, giving the impression that she is a weak ordinary woman, not like a powerful Great Heavenly Lord at all.
"Blue Creek?"
When Taishang heard the name, he said calmly, "It's a good name."
After saying that, Taishang raised his hand and destroyed the Great Heavenly Lord in front of him and the palace behind him.
